subject.title: bug: Duplicate messages sent to Slack

question: Should this issue stay open pending gateway log and Slack message-ID correlation, or is current main's Slack durable-send reconciliation enough evidence to close it as fixed?
rationale: The source now has multiple adjacent Slack duplicate guards, but only a maintainer/operator with access to the named session logs can safely map this report to one of them.

options.title: Keep open for log correlation
options.body: Preserve the issue until the named session, gateway delivery records, and Slack timestamps identify the duplicate source.

options.title: Close after matching a fixed path
options.body: Close as implemented only if logs show the duplicate came from the current durable-send, preview-edit, same-turn, or route-dedupe path now covered on main.

recommendation.title: Keep open for log correlation
recommendation.body: Preserve the issue until the named session, gateway delivery records, and Slack timestamps identify the duplicate source.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Slack delivery and reply-routing history makes this the best available routing candidate for deciding whether current send reconciliation covers the report.
